# graylog_pipeline (Resource)

Manages a Graylog processing pipeline. Pipelines are defined using the [Graylog Pipeline Rule Language](https://go2docs.graylog.org/current/making_sense_of_your_log_data/pipelines.html).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_pipeline" "example" {
  source = <<-EOT
    pipeline "Example Pipeline"
    stage 0 match either
      rule "extract fields"
    end
  EOT

  description = "An example processing pipeline"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) The pipeline source code in the Graylog Pipeline Rule Language.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the pipeline.
- `title` (String) The pipeline title. If omitted, Graylog parses it from the `source`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the pipeline was created.
- `id` (String) The pipeline ID.
- `modified_at` (String) Timestamp when the pipeline was last modified.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graylog_pipeline.example 69babedb10ce598257ccccec
```
